[QUERY] Have you experienced any unintentional weight loss over the past 1–2 months?

Anal fissures typically cause sharp, severe pain with defecation; hemorrhoids are often painless (unless thrombosed). Bright red blood *on toilet paper* or *coating stool* suggests distal source (e.g., hemorrhoids, fissure); maroon or occult blood may suggest more proximal sources. Also, family history of colorectal cancer or IBD would increase pretest probability. Since pain character and blood appearance are easily elicited and highly localizing, and haven’t been asked yet, they’re the most efficient next questions.
